## About
Discount Auto Air is a family operated shop in Arlington that specializes in auto A/C. When the Texas heat hits, we get your air blowing cold again, and when winter turns freezing, we handle heater repairs too.
A/C is our specialty, but we also take care of tune ups, maintenance, check engine light scans and all kinds of suspension work, from shocks to full air ride. The idea is simple: you shouldn't have to drive your car from shop to shop for different problems.
Reviewers know the owner as David, and they mention honest work and fair prices. Swing by Sturgeon Court or give us a call, and we will be happy to take care of you.

## Services
- A/C Freon charge: One of the lowest priced Freon charges around, at $39.99 plus tax. ($39.99 plus tax)
- A/C compressor repair: We work on A/C compressors to get your air blowing cold again.
- Heater repair: Heater repairs to keep you warm through a cold Texas winter.
- Suspension work: From lifts to complete air suspension.
- Check engine light repairs and scans: We scan the code and fix what's behind it.
- Tune ups and maintenance: Routine care to keep your vehicle running right.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge to diagnose the problem?
A: No. The diagnostic is free.

Q: Should I call before coming in?
A: Yes, give us a call first. We will tell you upfront if we have a spot for you or if it's better to drop the car off later.

Q: Do you only work on A/C?
A: A/C is our specialty, but we handle almost any kind of service your vehicle might need. Don't be afraid to ask.
